samples: This module calculates invoice totals by summing line items (quantity times unit price) and applying a percentage discount, with results rounded to the nearest cent. It provides functions to compute individual line totals, subtotals before discount, and final invoice totals, all with built-in validation ensuring quantities and prices are non-negative and discounts stay between 0 and 100 percent. The included tests verify that discounts are correctly applied and that empty invoices total to zero.
